Deploy NexFiscal API — produção

Arquivo:
    .github/workflows/docker.yml

Fluxo:
    Push na main → Build Docker → Push GHCR → SSH no servidor → Pull → Restart container

Container:
    nexfiscal-api-prod
    Porta host: 8085
    Rede Docker: network-nexfiscal
    Env file no servidor: /home/app/nexfiscal-api-prod.env

GitHub — environment "prod":
    Secrets:
        SERVER_HOST
        SERVER_USER
        SERVER_SSH_KEY
        SERVER_PORT

Exemplo /home/app/nexfiscal-api-prod.env:
    SERVER_PORT=8085
    DB_HOST=...
    DB_PORT=5432
    DB_NAME=nexfiscal
    DB_USERNAME=...
    DB_PASSWORD=...
    JWT_SECRET=...
    JWT_EXPIRATION_MINUTES=480
    ADMIN_EMAIL=...
    ADMIN_PASSWORD=...
    FRONTEND_URL=https://seu-dominio-front
    APP_SWAGGER_SERVER_URL=https://seu-dominio-api/api
    VIACEP_BASE_URL=https://viacep.com.br/ws
